studies.label: Absolute binding free energies of 11 BRD4(1) inhibitors from crystal poses

system.value: each of the 11 BRD4(1)-inhibitor complexes from crystal ligand poses (and each ligand decoupled in water)
system.where: Results: Absolute free energy calculations based on crystal structures

structure_source.value: holo crystal structures; ligand 11 modelled from 3SVG and docking into apo 2OSS (two binding modes); missing atoms built with WHAT-IF; hydrogens added with Maestro v9.5

ligands.value: BRD4(1) inhibitors 1-11 (one per complex); all crystallographic waters retained; other organic molecules removed

electrostatics.value: PME (real-space cut-off 12 Å, spline order 6, relative tolerance 1e-6, Fourier spacing 1.0 Å)

equilibration_restraints.value: solute heavy atoms, harmonic, 1000 kJ mol-1 nm-2

method_details.value: absolute binding free energy by alchemical double decoupling; linear lambda path, d(lambda) 0.05 vdW and 0.1 coulomb; 12 restraint lambdas; 42 complex and 31 ligand windows; Hamiltonian replica exchange (Gibbs sampling, swaps every 1000 steps); Boresch restraints (1 distance, 2 angles, 3 dihedrals, 10 kcal mol-1 Å-2 [deg-2]); soft-core vdW; long-range dispersion correction plus EXP-LR; Rocklin finite-size correction for charged ligands 1 and 4; MBAR with 200 bootstrap sets, first 1 ns of each window discarded
